name: Tutorial
description: Interactive step-by-step guided tutorial overlay with 13 steps covering the IDE surface: welcome, canvas pan/zoom, menu bar, terminal tool, dev explorer tool, markdown viewer, theme toggle, plugin cards, plugin list panel, arrange panel, keyboard shortcuts, and useful links. Highlights target DOM elements with a ring, positions tooltip near target, supports arrow-key and button navigation (Back/Next/Done/Skip). 'Do not show again' checkbox. Lifecycle hooks: onEnter/onLeave per step, optional renderExtra for custom content.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begin tutorial from step 0, store finish callback for prefs save

methods.description: Whether 'show on launch' checkbox is checked
